en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a town with a large villa-like building in the foreground, surrounded by trees and an outdoor garden or beer garden with many tables and chairs. Behind it are further townhouses and small multi‑storey buildings, with low hills in the distant background. Printed in red at the top is the caption "Radebeul-Oberlößnitz. Grundschänke." indicating the subject and locality.
